wellbore_instability (high)
page: MOR-001_DDR_2010-08-07.pdf#p1
cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Namsang, oversized cuttings at surface.
remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.
NPT: 16.95 h

stuck_pipe (high)
page: MOR-001_DDR_2010-08-08.pdf#p1
cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.
NPT: 11.3 h

overpressure (high)
page: MOR-001_DDR_2010-08-11.pdf#p1
cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Kopili, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
NPT: 24.58 h

data.name: medium
text:
stuck_pipe (medium)
page: MOR-001_DDR_2010-08-08.pdf#p1
cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stick.
remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 26 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 2.2 hrs.
NPT: 2.17 h
